اقترعتما (form VIII)
# اِقْتَرَعْتُمَا (iqtaraʕtumā) /iq.ta.raʕ.tu.maː/: second-person dual past active of اِقْتَرَعَ (iqtaraʕa)
# اُقْتُرِعْتُمَا (uqturiʕtumā) /uq.tu.riʕ.tu.maː/: second-person dual past passive of اِقْتَرَعَ (iqtaraʕa)
